passages.title: Travel & Expense Reimbursement
passages.text: Professional engineering licence renewals are reimbursed. Claim the renewal fee with the receipt. Fees for licences in additional jurisdictions are reimbursed when your manager agrees they are needed for your projects.

passages.title: Employee Handbook & Code of Conduct
passages.text: Only licensed professional engineers may seal or sign engineering drawings and calculations, and only for work they have personally reviewed. Never use another engineer's seal or signature. Keep your own licence current; licence renewals are reimbursed under RSE-EXP-01 §7.2. Engineers working toward licensure should work under the supervision of a licensed engineer and keep a record of their experience. Tell your manager straight away if your licence lapses or is restricted, so project responsibilities can be adjusted.

passages.title: Employee Handbook & Code of Conduct
passages.text: This handbook applies to every Ridgeline employee: full-time, part-time and interns. Contractors are not employees. A contractor is bound only by the Code of Conduct (§4), Health and Safety (§5), Reporting Concerns (§6) and the Information Security & Acceptable Use policy (RSE-SEC-01). Every other matter for a contractor, including time off, pay, benefits and working arrangements, is governed by their contract or agency. Contractors with questions about those matters should contact their agency or Ridgeline contract manager. Ridgeline's other HR policies do not apply to contractors. Managers who work with contractors should make sure the contractor knows which Ridgeline rules bind them: how to behave at work, how to stay safe on site, how to raise a concern and how to handle Ridgeline information and systems. Requests from contractors about anything else, such as taking time off or working from another location, are not decided by the contractor's Ridgeline manager under Ridgeline policy; they are settled under the contractor's own contract, through their agency or Ridgeline contract manager.

passages.title: Information Security & Acceptable Use
passages.text:
Always connect through the Ridgeline VPN when working off-site, including at home, on project sites and when travelling.
The VPN protects project data on networks Ridgeline doesn't control. If the VPN won't connect, stop working with Confidential and Client Restricted data and contact IT. Don't use another person's hotspot or network to get around a VPN problem.

passages.title: Onboarding Procedures
passages.text:
For HR questions, contact the HR Service Desk at hr@ridgeline.example or through HR Portal > Ask HR. For equipment and access problems, contact IT. For day-to-day questions about your work, start with your manager.
For sensitive concerns, use HR Confidential (RSE-HB-01 §6.1). For security incidents, contact IT Security straight away (RSE-SEC-01 §7.1). Your onboarding buddy can help you find your way around tools, teams and offices.

passages.title: Employee Handbook & Code of Conduct
passages.text: You can ask for a copy of the personal data HR holds about you, or ask for a correction, through the HR Service Desk. Most of your information can be checked and updated yourself in the HR Portal, such as your contact details and emergency contacts. For anything you can't change yourself, HR will respond to your request as soon as it can and tell you if any information has to be withheld to protect someone else's privacy.

args.query: benefits plans offered medical dental retirement

passages.title: Benefits Summary & Eligibility
passages.text:
Feature | Dental
Preventive care | Cleanings and check-ups covered in network
Basic and major care | Fillings, crowns and other treatment shared with the plan
You can join the dental plan even if you waive medical coverage, and you can choose a different coverage level for dental than for medical. Details of the dental network are in the plan documents.

passages.title: Benefits Summary & Eligibility
passages.text:
Benefits eligibility depends on your Employment Type. Full-time employees are eligible for all US plans in §2. Part-time employees are eligible for medical, dental, vision and the 401(k); Ridgeline's employer contribution to medical premiums is pro-rated by scheduled hours. Interns are eligible for the 401(k) only. Contractors are not eligible for Ridgeline benefits. Employees of the Toronto office are covered by the RSE Canada Group Plan instead of the US plans (§5).
Your eligibility is based on the Employment Type on your HR record. If your Employment Type changes, for example from part-time to full-time, your eligibility changes from the date of the change, and you can update your elections within the qualifying life event window (§3.4).
